name: Pendulum Squat
instructions: Stand on the pendulum squat machine with back against the pad, feet forward.
Unrack and lower into a deep squat, knees tracking over toes.
The machine's arc keeps the load on the quads with minimal back stress.
Drive up to full extension. A quad-dominant squat variation.
longevityNotes: Keep the squat pattern for life: depth and control matter more than load. Train it pain-free, leave reps in reserve, and your knees and hips will thank you at 80.
overview: An intermediate machine squat-pattern exercise for the quadriceps. Pendulum Squat develops leg strength through a full range of motion, which carries straight into daily life.
